title: Zephyr SE implementation scratchpad
content:
Morning quick dump for Zephyr Health implementation — ad-hoc notes and things to action. Rough, unfiltered.

Context: Zephyr wants private deployment with VPC peering -> Dedicated pool fallback during spikes. Main concerns: data egress policies, KMS integration, and strict latency SLOs for chat endpoints (p95 < 220ms for 128-token responses).

Topline TODO (priority order):
- [ ] Confirm KMS key ARN is Zephyr-prod-key (ask security for cross-account grant). Owner: Priya.
- [ ] Build VPC peering runbook (steps + iptables/route checks). Owner: Maya.
- [ ] Create Dedicated pool config proposal (3x A10g initial, autoscale=on, burst=2x). Draft PR: infra#312.
- [ ] Finalize model pin list: rllama-13b-q4 + rllama-70b-int8 fallback. Verify perf numbers.
- [ ] Write gating checklist for canary rollout (smoke, perf, quality eval).
- [ ] Ask legal for data retention SLA language (by EOD Wed).

Quick notes / config fragments to copy into runbook: 
- VPC peering notes:
  * Zephyr VPC CIDR: 10.45.0.0/16 (confirm)
  * Redwood private subnet: 10.78.32.0/19
  * Routes: add 10.45.0.0/16 -> peering-zen (verify propagation)
  * Security groups: allow 443 from 10.45.0.0/16 to inference-nodes

- KMS / secrets:
  * KMS key alias: alias/zephyr-prod-key (need policy allowing: redwood-control-plane@redwood-prod)
  * Secrets: ZE_KEY_ID, SLACK_WEBHOOK (for alerts), SAML_METADATA (for SSO)
  * Action: request cross-account decrypt in AWS console, include org account id 123456789012

- Model serving config snippet (notes):
  model: rllama-13b-q4
  max_tokens: 1024
  batch_size: auto (target latency < 220ms)
  kv_cache: enabled
  quant_profile: q4_optimized
  fallback_model: rllama-70b-int8 (for rare long-context requests)

- Autoscale heuristic (proposal):
  * scale_up_threshold: 80% GPU utilization over 2m
  * scale_down_threshold: < 35% over 5m
  * min_replicas: 3 (dedicated), max_replicas: 12
  * burst_policy: allow ephemeral extra nodes (2x) for 10m windows

Performance checks to run in staging (order):
1) simple gen p95 at 128 tokens - target <220ms
2) multi-tenant stress 95th token latency with batching turned on vs off
3) KV cache hit rate for repeated prompts (expect >60% hits on repeat flow)

Sample commands (local quick test):
- curl smoke: 
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rllama-13b-q4","input":"hello world","max_tokens":64}'

- debug to node: 
  rcli node proxy --env=zephyr-staging --node-id=node-03 --shell
  (then tail /var/log/inference/runtime.log)

Open questions / risks (to escalate):
- Does Zephyr require FIPS-compliant KMS? If yes, need to change key and validate runtime libs.
- Network egress restrictions: Are outbound calls to telemetry endpoints allowed? We need to list telemetry domains and add to allowlist or disable telemetry.
- Regulatory: Their legal team asked for SOC2 evidence for private deployment; coordinate with security to provide docs.

Meeting notes snippets (from 2024-11-05 call):
- Zephyr: "We need predictable tail latency during peak traffic windows" -> propose Dedicated with fallback to hosted in another region if capacity saturated.
- Action: send perf numbers + demo by Wed. (Assigned: Maya)

Short-term calendar plan:
- Mon/Tue: network + kms gating tasks
- Wed: perf runs in staging, assemble demo recording
- Thu: PR review + internal runbook review with SRE
- Fri: send onboarding checklist to Zephyr + request kick-off date

Notes to self (TODO ASAP):
- call security w/ Priya 10:30 to validate KMS policy
- draft runbook skeleton in Confluence under SE/Zephyr Onboarding (link above)
- tag infra PR with perf numbers once run completed

Rough timeline for customer-facing rollout: 2–3 weeks (network + KMS + perf validation) assuming no legal blockers.

Scratchy thoughts / heuristics:
- If KV cache hit rate is low, consider decreasing cache segmentation (coarser prefixes) or bumping memory per node.
- Quantization: q4 gives best perf/cost for 13b; for 70b int8 fallback might add 2-3x latency — ensure fallback used only for very long contexts.

Old inline snippets I might need:
- Jira checklist template: [ ] env created, [ ] peering set, [ ] kms granted, [ ] certs installed, [ ] smoke pass
- Slack pings: @dylan, @priamehta, @security-oncall

End of dump. Will tidy after the 11:00 sync.

Maya
